title: Common money mistakes young earners make
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: The costliest early mistakes are simple: spending first and saving what is left (instead of saving first), lifestyle inflation (raising your spending every time your pay rises), carrying credit-card balances, buying phones and gadgets on EMI, skipping an emergency fund and health insurance, mixing insurance with investment (endowment, money-back and ULIP plans that give low cover and low returns), chasing hot tips and 'doubling' schemes, investing money you may need soon, and never reviewing where money goes. A better habit loop: automate savings on salary day, pay card bills in full, build an emergency fund, buy pure term and health cover, invest regularly in low-cost diversified funds for long goals, and review your budget once a month.
summary_hinglish: Sabse mehngi galtiyan: pehle kharch phir bachat, lifestyle inflation, credit card balance, gadgets par EMI, emergency fund aur health insurance na hona, insurance aur investment ko mix karna (endowment/ULIP), tips ke peeche bhagna aur jald chahiye wala paisa invest karna. Salary wale din bachat automate karo aur mahine mein ek baar review karo.
summary_hi: सबसे महंगी गलतियां: पहले खर्च फिर बचत, लाइफस्टाइल इन्फ्लेशन, क्रेडिट कार्ड बैलेंस, गैजेट पर EMI, आपातकालीन फंड और हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस न होना, बीमा और निवेश को मिलाना (एंडोवमेंट/ULIP), टिप्स के पीछे भागना। सैलरी वाले दिन बचत ऑटोमेट करें और महीने में एक बार समीक्षा करें।
